perspective:
Ethan’s available information:

- He is a plumber and close, long-time friend of Gary Guo, a doctor. They met in middle school and have often relied on each other for support.
- Ethan noticed Gary was working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep, and he became concerned about Gary’s health.
- Ethan invited Gary to a two-day weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation. He told Gary that his health was important, that he hated seeing him like this, and that the retreat might give him a new perspective.
- Gary declined, saying he appreciated Ethan’s concern but could not go because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, Ethan observed Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspected there was more to Gary’s overworking than just professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, reminding him they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that Ethan was there to help, not judge.
- Gary told Ethan, “It’s complicated,” and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
- Gary later opened up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he was facing. Ethan felt relief and empathy and offered to help Gary find a better balance.
- Ethan suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities so Gary would not have to do everything himself.
- Gary agreed, saying he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary about his progress and challenges. Ethan saw Gary making efforts to change, felt hopeful and proud, and continued offering support and encouragement.
- Gary told Ethan things were better, that Ethan’s help meant he was not as overwhelmed, and that he had had time for a movie the previous weekend.
- After a year, Ethan saw that Gary was managing on his own with a healthier balance. Ethan felt satisfied and happy for him, decided to step back, and told Gary he was always just a call away, that he knew Gary had this, and to keep up the great work.
- Gary thanked Ethan, said he could not have done it without Ethan’s support, and said he felt more in control now.
